proof_summary: A stable run-length shape invariant gives an exact third-run-length identity and hence, for the row sums shifted by 3, a linear recurrence whose finite-difference state evolves under a fixed nonnegative $7\times7$ matrix. The relevant coordinate is bounded within constant factors of the orbit’s total mass, whose logarithm is almost subadditive, so Fekete’s lemma yields root-growth convergence; adding 3 and shifting indices do not affect the limit.
